keyFindingBeforeAnyEdit.finding: The dispatch's own premise -- 'the previous two pins both read 26 modules and 0 unresolved with a byte-identical set' -- does not reproduce. Running the current tracer (scripts/bake-module-graph.mjs) against the last documented pin (9873ff11) returns 258 modules, not 26.
keyFindingBeforeAnyEdit.rootCause: P-124/CTX-B2 (ac4b314, landed on hauska-factory main 2026-09-09T23:56:06 -0500) taught the tracer to cross @workspace/* package boundaries, pulling lib/cad-ingest (39 files) and lib/adapters (65 files) into the graph. This landed AFTER CTX-PIN2's own bump commit (b9ca9b4a, 2026-09-09T21:25:59 -0500) and CTX-B2's own close states explicitly it left cloudbuild.publish.yaml untouched. So the 26-module figure was never wrong when written; it went stale the moment CTX-B2 merged, and nothing in this file was ever updated to record that.
keyFindingBeforeAnyEdit.verification: CTX-B2's own close records the fixed tracer's 258-module set at 9873ff11 as a validated superset of a real esbuild build's 252 real inputs (6-module delta = esbuild's own type-only-import elision). This lane's independent reproduction of 258 at 9873ff11, using the current committed tracer, matches that ground truth exactly.
keyFindingBeforeAnyEdit.disposition: Per DEV_PROCESS 3.2, reported as a correction to the dispatch's own numbers rather than silently reconciled. Does not change item 1's outcome (the pin still needs to move to cebd041d) but changes what the comment can honestly claim about module counts for every entry back through CTX-BUILD.
